headline_finding: Source contamination, water scarcity, inadequate drinking water; pipe water supply defunct; individual household toilets extensively damaged; open defecation increased

78% rural Puri houses fully/significantly damaged; 70% Puri & Bhubaneswar slum houses damaged beyond repair; all kutcha houses in Brahmagiri, Puri Sadar, Gop, Nimapada fully damaged; occupants report inadequate food supply

Loss of cooking utensils and food stock; market closures and supply disruptions; essential item prices risen; 40% rural and 70% slum households have no food stock left; significant damages to standing & harvested crops
assessed_districts: Puri, Khordha, Jagatsinghpur, Cuttack (incl. Bhubaneswar slums)

headline_finding: Summer vacation mitigates short-term impact; extensive damages to school infrastructure, teaching & learning materials; loss of books, uniforms among poor households; Mid Day Meal supply discontinued
60% decline in access to healthcare; most District, PHC, CHC centres not fully functional; regular vaccination disrupted; heatwave conditions setting in; women's health vulnerabilities increased

Mixed-gender shelters lacking privacy; women's food intake decreased (apportioned to children & working males); domestic violence rising (heavy alcohol consumption, to be verified); women feel unsafe due to lack of light and loss of secure dwellings; children in shelters and open are more vulnerable
